items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: there's another boy there I just played with a couple of weeks ago I think his name is Wade Kincaid

ctx.x: trombone player Bill Cummins well what's the difference between Dixie and tailgate I mean you seem to make a distinction in your mind well there's so many of these

fellas that play so-called tailgate trombone as far as I'm concerned instead of playing trombone they're playing a tuba part the the real Dixie trombone as I see it he plays as a team with with the clarinet and trumpet and that's all the stuff that is so often called tailgate to the tuba and I that's of course that's the way I see it I could be so wrong I don't claim to be an authority I like to play but I don't claim to be an authority but getting back to these trombone players like I said we have a new one that…

well he in other words the drummer should have a sense of phrasing and meter and all of that just like the trumpet player absolutely that's the way I see it so he's playing a sort of our counterpoint in a way huh I mean you might even stretch it and call it that and he'll fill in holes and stuff that's right that's right
